abyssaldesignator.name: Abyssal Designator
abyssaldesignator.desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. Declare a Type and an Attribute. Your opponent must send 1 monster with both the declared Type and Attribute from their hand or Deck to the Graveyard.

assaultblackwingsayotherainhider.name: Assault Blackwing - Sayo the Rain Hider
assaultblackwingsayotherainhider.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
If this card is Synchro Summoned using a "Blackwing" monster as Material, it is treated as a Tuner while face-up on the field. Twice per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

bbusterdrake.name: B-Buster Drake
bbusterdrake.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 LIGHT Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card is unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Union monster from your Deck to your hand.

breathofthetistina.name: Breath of the Tistina
breathofthetistina.desc: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Tistina" monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) You can target 1 face-up monster you control, or if you control a LIGHT "Tistina" monster, you can target 1 face-up monster on the field instead; change that monster to face-down Defense Position, then add 1 "Tistina" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Breath of the Tistina". You can only use this effect of "Breath of the Tistina" once per turn.

cloudyskiesofgrey.name: Cloudy Skies of Grey
cloudyskiesofgrey.desc: Each time a "Cloudian" monster with a Fog Counter(s) is destroyed, place its Fog Counters on another face-up monster on the field.

crimsonninja.name: Crimson Ninja
crimsonninja.desc: FLIP: Target 1 Trap Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Trap Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

crosssheep.name: Cross-Sheep
crosssheep.desc:
2 monsters with different names
If a monster is Special Summoned to a zone this card points to: You can apply the following effects, in sequence, based on the card types of the monster(s) this card points to.
● Ritual: Draw 2 cards, then discard 2 cards. ● Fusion: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your GY. ● Synchro: All monsters you control gain 700 ATK. ● Xyz: All monsters your opponent controls lose 700 ATK.
You can only use this effect of "Cross-Sheep" once per turn.

darkfactoryofmassproduction.name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
darkfactoryofmassproduction.desc: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY; add them to your hand.

doomkraken.name: Doom Kraken
doomkraken.desc: If "Umi" is on the field (Quick Effect): You can target 1 WATER monster you control, except "Doom Kraken", and 1 monster your opponent controls; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return that monster you control to the hand, and if you do that, destroy that opponent's monster. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can return this card to the hand, and if you do, negate that attack. You can only use each effect of "Doom Kraken" once per turn.

dragunitydivinelance.name: Dragunity Divine Lance
dragunitydivinelance.desc: Equip only to a "Dragunity" monster. It gains ATK equal to its Level x 100, also it is unaffected by Trap effects. During your Main Phase: You can equip 1 Dragon-Type "Dragunity" Tuner monster from your Deck to the monster equipped with this card. You can only use this effect of "Dragunity Divine Lance" once per turn.

exosisterbetrayal.name: Exosister Betrayal
exosisterbetrayal.desc: When this card is activated: Add 2 "Exosister" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can target 1 face-up monster you control; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Exosister" monster mentioned on that monster. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY, even during the Damage Step: You can activate this effect; your opponent banishes 1 of them. You can only use each effect of "Exosister Betrayal" once per turn.

fusionsubstitute.name: Fusion Substitute
fusionsubstitute.desc:
(This card's name is always treated as "Polymerization".)
Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control as Fusion Material. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; return it to the Extra Deck, then draw 1 card.

garbagelord.name: Garbage Lord
garbagelord.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by paying 2000 Life Points. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a DARK monster.

gluttonousreptolphingreethys.name: Gluttonous Reptolphin Greethys
gluttonousreptolphingreethys.desc: You can target 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster in your GY with an equal or lower Level than the number of cards in your opponent's hand; Special Summon it, but it cannot activate its effects this turn. You can only use this effect of "Gluttonous Reptolphin Greethys" once per turn. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can make the Synchro Monster that used this card as material gain 200 ATK/DEF for each card currently in your opponent's hand.

jurracvelo.name: Jurrac Velo
jurracvelo.desc: When this face-up Attack Position card attacks or is attacked, and it is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Jurrac" monster with 1700 or less ATK from your Deck.

machineconversionfactory.name: Machine Conversion Factory
machineconversionfactory.desc: Equip only to a Machine monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

morphtronicdatatron.name: Morphtronic Datatron
morphtronicdatatron.desc: ● While in Attack Position: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 monster to inflict 600 damage to your opponent. ● While in Defense Position: Once per turn, you can inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

superalloybeastraptinus.name: Superalloy Beast Raptinus
superalloybeastraptinus.desc:
1 Gemini Monster + 1 Gemini Monster
All Gemini Monsters on the field are treated as Effect Monsters, and gain their effects.

superquantalmechbeastlusterrex.name: Super Quantal Mech Beast Lusterrex
superquantalmechbeastlusterrex.desc:
2 Level 7 monsters
Cannot attack unless it has material. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 Effect Monster on the field; negate that face-up monster's effects until the end of this turn. This is a Quick Effect if this card has "Super Quantum White Layer" as material. Once per turn: You can attach 1 "Super Quantum" monster from your hand or field to this card as material.

thecalculator.name: The Calculator
thecalculator.desc: The ATK of this card is the combined Levels of all face-up monsters you control x 300.

toybox.name: Toy Box

trickstarfoxglovewitch.name: Trickstar Foxglove Witch
trickstarfoxglovewitch.desc:
2+ Fairy monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card they control. If this Link Summoned card is destroyed by battle or effect: You can Special Summon 1 Link-2 or lower "Trickstar" monster from your Extra Deck, then inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card they control. You can only use each effect of "Trickstar Foxglove Witch" once per turn.

unitedwestand.name: United We Stand
unitedwestand.desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK/DEF for each face-up monster you control.

vylonepsilon.name: Vylon Epsilon
vylonepsilon.desc:
1 LIGHT Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Equip Cards equipped to this card cannot be targeted by cards or effects. Once per turn: You can send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
